Explain how a VPN works in simple words
6:09 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and the internet. Everything you send goes through it in scrambled form, so your Wi-Fi owner or internet company can't read it.

Your data first reaches the VPN company's computer, which then talks to the website for you. The website sees that computer's address instead of yours, so your location looks different too.

It helps on public Wi-Fi and hides your browsing from your internet company. It doesn't make you anonymous, though, since the VPN company can still see what you do. Pick one you trust.
